title: [TT-NOP-Injector][WH] mismatch race on eltwise_binary dest_reuse
body:
Sub-issue of #53394 (TT-NOP injector tool race findings - LLK).

## Summary

Wormhole `DEST_TO_SRCA` Elwmul dest-reuse mismatches when unpack sync is delayed.

**Deterministic:** two full `1-100` sweeps,  Same 8 variants mismatched both times

| site | addr | source | NOP | failing n |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| unpack:2 `STALLWAIT` | `0x05a28` | `llk_unpack_AB.h:274` `TTI_STALLWAIT(STALL_UNPACK, TRISC_CFG)` | `unpacr1` | 12 |
| unpack:2 `STALLWAIT` | `0x05a28` | `llk_unpack_AB.h:274` | `unpacr0` | 14 |
| unpack:2 `STALLWAIT` | `0x05a28` | `llk_unpack_AB.h:274` | `tti_nop` | 30, 33 |
| unpack:2 `STALLWAIT` | `0x05a28` | `llk_unpack_AB.h:274` | `risc_nop` | 30, 33 |
| unpack:3 `SEMGET` | `0x05a30` | `ckernel.h:319` `TTI_SEMGET` via `llk_unpack_AB.h:280` `t6_semaphore_get(UNPACK_SYNC)` | `unpacr1` | 13 |
| unpack:3 `SEMGET` | `0x05a30` | `ckernel.h:319` / `llk_unpack_AB.h:280` | `unpacr0` | 15 |

Math thread had no recorded misses. Kernel: `eltwise_binary_test.cpp:69` `run_kernel` → `_llk_unpack_AB_`.

## Recreate

Branch: [`nmohammed/timing-perturbations-tt-llk`](https://github.com/tenstorrent/tt-metal/tree/nmohammed/timing-perturbations-tt-llk)

```bash
cd tt_metal/tt-llk/tests/python_tests/ttnop

# STALLWAIT @ llk_unpack_AB.h:274 — tti_nop 30,33 (also risc_nop 30,33; unpacr1 12; unpacr0 14)
CHIP_ARCH=wormhole ./focus.sh --site sync --sites unpack:2 --nop tti_nop \
  --delays 30,33 --repeats 5 \
  'test_eltwise_binary.py::test_eltwise_binary_dest_reuse[reuse_dest_type:DEST_TO_SRCA-math_op:Elwmul-formats:Float32->Float32-math_fidelity:HiFi3-tile_dimensions:[16, 32]-input_dimensions:[512, 32]-output_dimensions:[128, 32]]'

```
